Application Materials.content:
Fill in the application form and upload the following supporting documents:
- **CV or Resume**: Concise document no more than **3 pages**, briefly describing your responsibilities and accomplishments.
- **Educational Documents**: Degree scroll/certificate(s) and academic transcripts of each university attended; official English translation is required for non-English certificates and transcripts.
- **Passport Photo**: Coloured photo taken within the last **3 months** in hi-resolution jpeg format.
- **Passport or NRIC**: International applicants must have a valid passport on hand and complete a video identification within the application. Singapore Citizens and SPR should use NRIC. Applicants are also required to upload a scanned copy of passport or NRIC.
- **GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE Score Report**: Applicants may upload an unofficial or test taker copy if official test scores are not on hand. Official test scores should be sent to Nanyang Business School; GMAT institution code **V24-ZV-70** and GRE ID code **3123**. Applicants who have yet to take the GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE and TOEFL/IELTS may still submit their application and indicate the test dates in the online application form.
- **TOEFL or IELTS score report**: Required if English was not the medium of instruction used at the tertiary level.
- **Referee Reports**: Applicants are required to nominate **two referees** in the online application form. Upon nomination, an online referee report form will be sent to them for completion. All referee reports must be submitted from an official institution or organisational email address; submissions from personal email addresses will not be accepted.
- **Professional Membership Certificates, if any**.
The essay questions are compulsory and applicants should articulate their thoughts clearly, using good judgement with respect to the word limit. No separate application for scholarships is required; applicants should tick the box relating to the scholarship in the online application form and complete the essay for scholarship consideration.
For scholarship consideration, applicants should complete the scholarship part of the online application, including the scholarship essay. Scholarship applications must be completed, including submission of all supporting documents, by the **30 November 2025** deadline. Scholarship application will only be considered when it is submitted together with the application.

Interview Requirements.content:
- After assessment of your application is completed, candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. The interview is **by invitation only** and shortlisted candidates will be informed via e-mail.
- The announcement of shortlisted candidates will be made after the deadline of the application round and is not a one-time exercise; subsequent announcements will also be made as warranted.
- Admissions interviews for shortlisted candidates will be recorded as part of the selection process.
- Candidates who have successfully completed the interview will move to the final selection stage, where the Admissions Committee will deliberate and select candidates for admission.

Application Deadlines.content:
The MSBA programme will start in July. The application for the July 2026 intake will start in September 2025. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and early application improves your chances of being shortlisted sooner.
- Round 1: **30 November 2025**
- Round 2: **31 January 2026**
- Round 3: **31 March 2026**

Academic Requirements.content:
- MSc Business Analytics (MSBA) minimum admission requirements include **a good bachelor’s degree in any discipline**.
- **Applicants with no work experience are welcome to apply.**
- The above are minimum admission requirements. Meeting these criteria does not guarantee admission, as selection is competitive.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- To apply for the MSc Business Analytics (MSBA) programme, applicants need **a good GMAT or GRE score**.
- Graduates from a Singapore autonomous university are exempted from GMAT or GRE. Graduates from leading universities may be granted an exemption on a case-by-case basis.
- The institutional codes are: GMAT: **V24-ZV-70**; GRE: **3123**.
- **GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE Score Report**: You may upload your unofficial or test taker copy, if you do not have your official test scores on hand. Please arrange to have your official test scores sent to Nanyang Business School. Our GMAT institution code is **V24-ZV-70** and our GRE ID code is **3123**.
- Applicants who have yet to take the GMAT/GMAT Focus or GRE and TOEFL/IELTS may still proceed to submit their application and indicate the test dates in the online application form.
- **Important:** We no longer accept GMAT/GRE online test scores taken **after 31 December 2023**. Only in-person test results are considered valid.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
TOEFL is required if the medium of instruction during your undergraduate studies was not in English. IELTS may be accepted in place of TOEFL.
An acceptable score for TOEFL is **600 (paper based), 250 (computer based) and 100 (internet based)**. For IELTS, the acceptable score is **6.5 and above**.

Program Overview.content:
The MSc Business Analytics at Nanyang Business School equips students to excel in business analytics. The curriculum imparts a strong commercial sense through business strategy and tools to gain insights from data analysis, with a hands-on approach that allows students to apply classroom knowledge to real-world business situations. Graduates will be able to lead analytics projects as the head of a business unit and analytics business lead, or as professional consultants with business domain expertise.
MSBA is offered as a **full-time, one-year programme**. The programme is delivered entirely in English on the main campus at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.
The Data Analytics Practicum taps on industry and business environments as teaching platforms for students to acquire real-life working experience in data analytics applications and apply theory and skills from classroom settings to actual project environments. Students work full-time for at least **12 weeks** on relevant data analytics/AI projects through either a Work Track with Singapore-registered companies, organisations, or agencies, or a Project Track supervised by faculty on data-analytics-related projects.
Organisations are looking for graduates who are adept at working with large data sets, applying insights and business intelligence to solve business needs and drive transformation. Through the programme’s strong industry partnerships, students can take advantage of internship opportunities with industry leaders such as DBS, KPMG, and GE Digital, providing hands-on experience and preparation for a career in business analytics.

Project Track students may work in a group of up to 4 on projects that may include a supervisor’s consulting project sponsored by industry partners, a supervisor’s ongoing research project, or a capstone project proposed primarily by students.

Financial Aid.content:
No separate application for scholarships is required – simply tick on the box relating to the scholarship you are applying for in the online application form and complete the essay for scholarship consideration.
- **MSc Business Analytics Merit Scholarship:** NBS offers partial scholarships to stellar candidates, on a competitive basis. Only applicants who have been offered a place in MSc Business Analytics programme are eligible for the scholarships. The partial scholarship will go towards off-setting the fees of the programme, and does not cover the living expenses in Singapore, travel and accommodation.
- **Eligibility Criteria:** Possess excellent academic credentials; performed well in the admission interview; granted admission to the MSc Business Analytics Programme.
- **How to Apply:** Please complete the scholarship part of the online application, including the scholarship essay. Applicants who wish to be considered for the scholarship should ensure that their scholarship applications are completed, including submission of all supporting documents, by [30 November 2025 deadline](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-business-analytics/admissions#round-1). Scholarship application will only be considered when it is submitted together with the application.
- **ASEAN Development Scholarship:** This partial scholarship is awarded to nationals of ASEAN member countries, excluding Singapore. Recipients may receive up to **90% funding towards their tuition fee**. Scholarship applicants must possess strong academic records, demonstrated leadership qualities and potential, and for working professionals, a strong career progression. A complete online application including the scholarship section, and required supporting documents must be submitted by the [first round application deadline](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-business-analytics/admissions#round-1) to be eligible.
- **Diversity Scholarship:** Each scholarship awarded covers **40% of the tuition fees**. Applicants must showcase a distinctive background, demonstrate how it enhances the broader understanding of diversity, and possess a track record of success in initiatives or activities that promote diversity within their communities or workplaces. A complete online application including the scholarship section, and required supporting documents must be submitted by the [first round of application deadline](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/msc-business-analytics/admissions#round-1) to be eligible.
- **SG Digital Scholarship By Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA):** Singapore citizens may wish to consider the SG Digital Scholarship to finance their studies. More information about the scholarship can be found [here](https://www.imda.gov.sg/Singapore-Digital-Scholarship-postgraduate).
- **NTU Alumni Grant:** NTU alumni who have completed a bachelor’s or post-graduate degree at NTU are eligible for an alumni grant of **10% of the tuition fees**. The subsidy can only be used to offset the tuition fee and cannot be used to offset other costs such as student service fees or miscellaneous fees.
- **Singapore Citizen & Singapore PR Grant:** Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents are eligible for a grant of **$5000**. The subsidy can only be used to offset the tuition fee and cannot be used to offset other costs such as student service fees or miscellaneous fees.
- **SkillsFuture Credit:** SkillsFuture Credit aims to encourage individual ownership of skills development and lifelong learning. All Singaporeans aged 25 and above will receive an opening credit of **S$500** from January 2016. The MSBA programme is a certified course under this programme. Please click [here](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/credit) for more information on the disbursement of the credit.

Multiple Applications.content:
Ranking is compulsory in the [application portal](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/graduate/cwadmissionguide). You will not be able to rank your application choices only if you have already received an outcome from NTU for your application. Your applications will be assessed separately by the different schools. If you are selected by both schools, you may receive multiple offers and may proceed to accept 1 programme as your final choice.
To apply for both CCDS and MSE programmes, you would need to submit two separate online applications. You can apply at [NTU Graduate Online Application](https://gradadmissions.ntu.edu.sg/apply/).

Deferral Admission Policy.content: Yes, you may request for a deferment. However, you must accept the course offer and make the enrolment deposit before request for a deferment can be made.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
A conditional offer is extended to an applicant who is in the process of completing the final term, semester, or trimester of their current course of study, and has outstanding educational documents. This condition will be clearly outlined in the offer letter, stating: "The offer of admission is on condition that you obtain your Bachelor's degree with a ________ from ___________ , ___________ "
For **Conditional Offer** (i.e. subject to attaining a Bachelor/ Masters’ degree), you are required to upload your **Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scrolls and Official Transcript** (Original and English Language translated). If you are unable to upload your Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scroll during verification period, you are to upload **a letter of completion** from your university stating that you have completed and attained Bachelor/ Masters’ degree. Do not complete e-verification if you do not meet the condition stated on the offer letter. Kindly contact your school for assistance.
**International Student with International Qualification**:
- Official degree certificate and final transcript
- Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only)
- Degree verification report (English) from NTU approved credential verification agency within **one month of your term start date**
- Latest Passport (If not yet submitted)
